maddeler.e:
نرتهن (form VIII)
# نَرْتَهِنُ (nartahinu) /nar.ta.hi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# نُرْتَهَنُ (nurtahanu) /nur.ta.ha.nu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# نَرْتَهِنَ (nartahina) /nar.ta.hi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# نُرْتَهَنَ (nurtahana) /nur.ta.ha.na/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
